definitions: To express a decision made at the moment of speaking to move or act with great speed.
To indicate a promise or intention to expedite an action or process.
To convey a spontaneous offer to accelerate one's pace.
examples: Oh, the train leaves in five minutes! I will hurry.
Don't worry, I will hurry and get there as fast as possible.
If you need me to be quick, I will hurry.
